We also have budget $7200 for two people. Should roughly allocate accommodation costs, transportation, meals. But not required to compute cost, just plan.

We need to call submit_day_plan for each day (7 days). Provide day number, current_city (or from-to). Transportation details (flights, drives). Breakfast, attractions (multiple separated by ';'), lunch, dinner, accommodation.

We must not ask follow-up. So generate plausible plan.

Cities: Key West (FL) start. Then Texas cities: e.g., Houston, San Antonio, Austin (or Dallas). Choose three. Let's pick Houston, San Antonio, Austin.

Sequence: Day 1 March 3: Key West (maybe enjoy local). Travel to Houston (flight). Day 2 March 4: Houston. Day 3 March5: San Antonio (drive). Day4 March6: San Antonio. Day5 March7: Austin (drive). Day6 March8: Austin. Day7 March9: Return to Key West or depart? Could travel back to Key West (flight) or perhaps end in Austin. Since trip ends March9, could return to Key West. Now need to include cuisines: Mexican, Italian, Chinese, American. Spread across meals.

Transportation: flights from Key West to Houston (maybe via Miami). Provide flight details. Then driving distances.

Let's craft each day.

Day1: Key West. Breakfast at "Blue Heaven" (American). Attractions: "Ernest Hemingway Home, Key West; Mallory Square, Key West". Lunch: maybe "El Meson de Pepe" (Cuban). But need Mexican, Italian, Chinese, American across days. Day1 lunch maybe Mexican? Could have "El Meson" is Cuban. Better to have Mexican for lunch day1: "El Meson de Pepe" is not Mexican. Use "Blue Heaven" breakfast, lunch "El Meson de Pepe" (maybe not needed). But we need Mexican somewhere else. We'll schedule Mexican lunch day2 in Houston.

Day1 dinner: Italian "Cafe du Monde"? That's French. Use "Pietro's Italian Restaurant". Provide.

Accommodation: "The Marquesa Hotel, Key West (entire suite)".

Transportation: "-".

Day4 March6: San Antonio day. Breakfast: "The Guenther House". Attractions: "San Antonio Museum of Art; Tower of the Americas (actually in Austin). Let's pick "San Antonio Missions National Historical Park". Lunch: Italian "Il Forno". Dinner: American "The Pearl Brewery's Food Hall". Accommodation same.

Day5 March7: Travel San Antonio to Austin by car. Transportation details. Breakfast: "Hotel Breakfast". Attractions: "Texas State Capitol, Austin; Zilker Park". Lunch: Mexican "Torchy's Tacos". Dinner: Chinese "Jade Asian Kitchen". Accommodation: "Kimpton Hotel Van Zandt".

Day6 March8: Austin day. Breakfast: "Juan in a Million (Tex-Mex)". Attractions: "Barton Springs Pool; Lady Bird Lake". Lunch: Italian "North Italia". Dinner: American "Franklin Barbecue". Accommodation same.

Day7 March9: Travel back to Key West (flight from Austin to Key West via connecting). Transportation: "Flight, Austin to Key West, Departure 10:00, Arrival 16:00". Breakfast: "Hotel Breakfast". Lunch: maybe at airport. We'll set lunch "Mexican - La Fogata (Austin)". Dinner: "Italian - Gianni's (Key West)". Accommodation maybe end.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan
